title: test(drivers): a keyset walk by id visits every organization member once, in the driver's order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8RurSHJiXrGwyzL5u3wQjiC)_

Fixes #29398

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加测试。五个 driver 包各加一份一致性钉子:按组织成员补全读的同一查询形状(`organization_id` + `id $gt` 游标、`orderBy id`、`limit`)做 keyset 分页,断言跨页拼起来恰好等于一次不分页的有序读,每个成员恰一次、不混入别的组织。
- 为什么改:卡的第 1 项原本要在解析器里加 JavaScript 的「id 严格递增」校验,已实测证伪(数据库按 collation 排序,ICU en-US 下大小写混排的 id 顺序与码点不同,会让每一页都 503)。席位改判为:解析器不加校验,改由 driver 一致性测试钉住「游标与排序用同一比较」。
- 风险与回滚:不改任何运行时代码,不发布(测试文件不进 `dist`),`skip-changeset`;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts`(按方言单元跑,含 live Postgres/MySQL),再看 `driver-memory` 的同名钉子。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts`,预期 sqlite 单元 4 个通过、未配置的 live 单元为具名跳过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Test files only, one per driver package. Each walks a `sys_member`-shaped table with the exact query shape of `readOrganizationMembersToCompletion` in `@objectstack/core`: `where { organization_id }` then `{ organization_id, id: { $gt: after } }`, `orderBy id asc`, a `limit`, `fields: ['id', 'user_id']`, resuming after each full page's last id. For page sizes 1, 3, 4 (an exact multiple of the 16 rows) and 16, it asserts:

- the pages joined are the same sequence as one unpaged `orderBy id` read, so the order asserted is the driver's own, never JavaScript's;
- every member id appears once, and no row of the other organization appears;
- each row carries its `user_id` through the projection;
- the number of reads is the keyset's (`floor(16 / pageSize) + 1`), and a walk that does not end fails instead of hanging.

The fixture ids are mixed-case nanoid-alphabet values (`AC Ab9 B-2 a-c aB3 ab b_1 0Zz Z0 z_9 _x -y Mm mN1 n Q-q`), no two equal after case folding, plus three ids of another organization.

| Package | File | Runs |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `driver-sql` | `sql-driver-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts` | every `DIALECT_CELLS` cell: sqlite always; live Postgres and MySQL when `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` / `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL` are set (CI: `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, which runs the whole package) |
| `driver-memory` | `memory-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts` | always |
| `driver-sqlite-wasm` | `sqlite-wasm-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts` | always |
| `driver-turso` | `turso-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts` | always (local mode) |
| `driver-mongodb` | `mongodb-member-keyset-walk-conformance.test.ts` | opt-in, like the package's other live suites (`OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED=1`); a named skip otherwise |

No changeset: no published file changes. Every driver package publishes only `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`; after a build, `member-keyset` and `org_walked` have zero hits under the drivers' `dist`, and the control (`ORDER` in `driver-sql/dist/index.js`) hits. The PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Why

Item 2 of the card landed as #29545. Item 1 asked for a per-page "each id strictly greater than the last" check in the resolver. That check compares in JavaScript code-point order, but `driver-sql` orders and pages by the database collation, so on an ICU `en-US` PostgreSQL database it would refuse every correctly ordered page (measured in the report on the card). The seat ruled: no order check in `resolve-authz-context.ts`; instead, a driver conformance pin that the keyset walk returns every row once, in the driver's order, across page boundaries. That is this PR. `resolve-authz-context.ts` and every driver are untouched.

## Tests

<details><summary>Per driver (head 1647e3243a)</summary>

- `driver-sql`, sqlite cell: Tests 4 passed, 2 skipped (the unprovisioned live Postgres and MySQL cells, named).
- `driver-sql` against a local PostgreSQL 16, two databases: `C.UTF-8` and ICU `en-US` (`CREATE DATABASE ... LOCALE_PROVIDER icu ICU_LOCALE 'en-US'`). Both: Tests 8 passed, 1 skipped (MySQL). The two databases order the fixture differently, so both a code-point order and a non-code-point order were walked:
  - `C.UTF-8` (same as JavaScript): `-y 0Zz AC Ab9 B-2 Mm Q-q Z0 _x a-c aB3 ab b_1 mN1 n z_9`
  - ICU `en-US`: `_x -y 0Zz a-c ab aB3 Ab9 AC b_1 B-2 Mm mN1 n Q-q z_9 Z0`
- `driver-memory`: Tests 4 passed. `driver-sqlite-wasm`: Tests 4 passed. `driver-turso`: Tests 4 passed.
- `driver-mongodb`: Tests 4 skipped. NOT MEASURED: no mongod here; the binary download host is refused by this container's proxy (403). No CI job sets `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED`, so CI does not run it either, as for the package's existing pagination suite.
- MySQL: NOT MEASURED locally (no server here); CI's live job runs it after merge.
- `pnpm typecheck` for the five driver packages: exit 0 (head 3784be1f; the later commit only merges `main`). The four `src` test files are in their package's `tsc` file list; the mongodb one is compiled by its `check:test-typecheck` step (OK).
</details>

<details><summary>The pin can fail (one-time mutation, no file kept)</summary>

A scratch copy of the `driver-sql` pin wrapped `find` so that every paged read returned its rows reversed (a driver whose pages are not in its own order). Run on sqlite and on the ICU `en-US` database, then deleted (`git status` clean afterwards):

- sqlite: Tests 3 failed, 1 passed. Pages of 3, 4 and 16 are red (`expected [ 'AC', '0Zz', '-y', 'Ab9', …(40) ] to deeply equal [ '-y', '0Zz', 'AC', 'Ab9', …(12) ]`); pages of 1 stay green, since a one-row page has no order to lose.
- ICU `en-US` Postgres: Tests 6 failed, 2 passed, the same split in both cells.

A second scratch copy dropped `orderBy` from every paged read instead. It stayed green on both, because `driver-sql` adds an `id` order to a limited read that names none. That is a reading about the driver, not a gap in the pin.
</details>

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (head 1647e3243a)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 49 commands. All 49 were run locally with exit codes captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `--ran` reconciled them: 49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The five artifact-roster families whose roster sits under a changed directory, run as well: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:object-def-param-keys`, `check:tenant-chokepoint`. All exited 0.
- `pnpm lint` exited 0.
- A first pass on an earlier head turned up one real red: `check:query-options-erasure` counted the test surface growing 236 to 246, because each pin cast its `find` options `as any`. The casts were removed (the options type-check as written), and the gate now reads 236, at the ceiling.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed `git fetch --unshallow` (its fixture is pinned to an old commit).
- Not run here: `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` skips pull requests and the merge queue, so the live Postgres and MySQL cells of the `driver-sql` pin first run in `main`'s push battery after merge. The local Postgres readings above stand in for the Postgres half.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The drivers' shared conformance cases live in `@objectstack/spec/data` (`PAGINATION_CASES` and its siblings). This change does not edit `packages/spec`, so each driver package carries its own copy of the fixture and the walk. Hoisting them into `@objectstack/spec/data` beside the pagination cases is a later choice, not a gap.
- The pin follows the resolver's query shape by copy. If `readOrganizationMembersToCompletion` changes its shape, these files do not change with it.
- MySQL's `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci` is case-insensitive. Two ids equal after case folding would collide on a case-insensitive primary key at insert, so the fixture holds none. That is a different fact from the one pinned here, and it was not measured.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
